name: Double Dragon
description:
Re-experience the first handheld appearance of the acclaimed Double Dragon series!

In this side-scrolling beat 'em up you fight your way through rival gangs' turfs using jumps, punches, kicks and more to save the kidnapped girl Marian.

This version of the game does not have multiplayer functionality.
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
